column1: # Game profile of BioShock 2 Remastered (Switch, update 1.0.2 = v65536). Plays on the Mac
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file
# Blind Squirrel's Unreal Engine 3 port of 2K Marin's BioShock 2, SDK 9, NVN. Same module pair as BioShock Remastered: main and sdk, rtld replaced by the host.
# The shaders are the RomFS's own caches, shadercache.nx and startupshadercache.nx, at container version 28 (shader_split.py shadercache_nx):
# 20,367 keys out of the first and 9 out of the second. Nothing is captured: the whole set exists before the first frame.
# The legal pages end with the browser's close(), which dm/host/web_apple.m answers as exit reason 4; the game then writes its own first-run save (FirstRun.nx).
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so main sets its own heap: at most the pool less 64 MB. The split below is the survey's, as on BioShock Remastered:
# it boots, plays and saves, but was not measured against hardware (README.md, What is open)
